title: English detectorist finds rare 380-year-old coin in Essex field after months of searching
summary_full: Discoveries like this don't happen every day! A metal detector enthusiast in Essex came across a remarkable silver coin, dating to 1646, in a farmer's field. Dubbed a siege piece from the English Civil War that spanned 1642 to 1651, the coin bears the initials of King Charles I, suggesting a Royalist connection.
